item.title: If We Survive | Andrew Klavan
item.description: They came on a mission of mercy, but now they’re in a fight for their lives.

item.title: Nightmare City | Andrew Klavan
item.description: What should have been an ordinary morning is about to spiral into a day of unrelenting terror.

item.title: MindWar: Book 1 | Teen & Young Adult Book | Andrew Klavan
item.description: MindWar: Book 1. MindWar Trilogy. Rick Dial was the best quarterback Putnam Hills High School had ever seen. Unflappable. Unstoppable. Number 12. But when a car accident left him crippled, Rick’s life as he knew it ended.

item.title: Werewolf Cop: A Novel | Adult Fiction Book | Andrew Klavan
item.description: From Edgar Award-winning Andrew Klavan, a supernatural thriller about a good cop in the grips of an evil curse: the first in a trilogy about a crime-fighter on a quest to control the beast within.

item.title: Hostage Run: MindWar Trilogy | Teen & Young Adult | Andrew Klavan
item.description: Rick Dial’s career as a superstar quarterback ended when a car accident left him unable to walk. But his uncanny gaming ability caught the attention of a secret government organization trying to stop a high-tech terrorist attack on America.

item.title: Game Over: MindWar Trilogy | Teen & Young Adult | Andrew Klavan
item.description: Game Over: The MindWar Realm is a computerized world created by a deranged terrorist named Kurodar. Built through a link between Kurodar’s mind and a network of supercomputers, The Realm is a pathway the madman can project himself into any computer system on the planet.

item.title: The Great Good Thing | Biography & Memoir | Andrew Klavan
item.description: Edgar Award-winner and internationally bestselling novelist tells of his improbable conversion from agnostic Jewish-intellectual to baptized Christian and of the books that led him there.

item.title: Another Kingdom, Book 1 | Andrew Klavan | Bestselling Author
item.description: “What was this place? Was I crazy? Or was I crazy before, back in L.A.? Was my real life some sort of dream? Was this hell reality?”

item.title: Another Kingdom, Book 1 | Andrew Klavan | Bestselling Author
item.description: Another Kingdom, Book 1 is Andrew Klavan's latest novel and is scheduled for release March 5th, 2019. Austin Lively is stuck between dual realities while his monotonous life has become an epic adventure of magic, murder, and political intrigue.
